A widget can sit on a lock screen. The private widget never shows an app name, a topic or a number a stranger could use, and the public widget only ever repeats what you already published.
Widgets read from the on-device database only. Removing the widget does not remove any data, and adding it does not start any collection.

J27 · Home-screen widget

A lock-screen surface: totals privately, published topics only in public.

home-screen widgetneeds DP4

Rendered over dashboard, because that is what it is: a home-screen widget.

What this file is

Rendered by packages/ui/mockups/render.mjs from the real components in packages/ui/screens through the DOM binding, with the generated token CSS inlined. It is not a drawing of the screen.

What to check

An "empty" frame is rendered for a persona that lacks a tier this screen needs, so it shows the real degraded state: what Mirror says when it cannot measure something.

Reproduce

npm run tokens && npm run mockups

All screens
